requestProfile.nonce: deterministic synthetic 128-bit integer derived from payload digest and protocol ID

qualificationGates: hashedMessage equals SHA-256 of the exact payload bytes
nonce equals the sealed request manifest
TimeStampResp status is granted or grantedWithMods
TSA certificate has timeStamping EKU and chains to an independently trusted root
CMS signature and signed attributes verify
genTime, policy, serial, accuracy, ordering, and nonce satisfy the frozen appraisal policy

currentBoundary.reason: The environment has no OpenSSL executable and no external TSA response or trust anchor. The CLI therefore verifies request construction and refuses trusted-time qualification.

externalVerificationInterface.backend: openssl ts -verify when an OpenSSL executable, response, request, and explicit CA file are supplied
externalVerificationInterface.failureRule: Missing backend, response, CA file, signature verification, imprint match, or nonce match yields unqualified rather than partial success.

nonClaims: The deterministic synthetic nonce is reproducible test data, not a production randomness source.
A valid TimeStampReq is not evidence that a TSA received it.
A Git commit time is not substituted for a TimeStampToken.
No external TSA, certificate chain, CMS signature, genTime, accuracy, or ordering property is verified in RC32.
